title: OGC API to MCP Tool Contract
description: A formal, extensible translation from selected OGC API capabilities into stable Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools. The contract is an implementation-neutral profile for discovery, Features, Records, Processes, and proxy governance. It is a project artifact for interoperability research and is not an adopted OGC Standard.

compatibility.tool_name_stability: Existing tool names are stable within major version 0 and use the ogc_ prefix.
compatibility.additive_evolution: New optional fields, modules, tools, and x-* extension fields may be added in a backward-compatible minor version.
compatibility.breaking_change_policy: Removing a tool, changing a required argument, changing a required result field, or changing a lifecycle transition requires a new major contract version.
compatibility.consumer_rule: Consumers MUST ignore unknown x-* fields and SHOULD ignore unknown optional fields they do not understand.

normative_language.MUST: An absolute interoperability or safety requirement.
normative_language.SHOULD: A strong recommendation; deviations require a documented reason.
normative_language.MAY: An optional capability or implementation choice.

mcp_concepts.tool: A named MCP function with a JSON Schema argument contract and a structured result envelope.
mcp_concepts.resource: A read-only MCP URI that exposes non-secret documentation or registry metadata.
mcp_concepts.server_id: An opaque operator-controlled identifier selecting a configured OGC deployment; it is never an arbitrary URL supplied by an MCP caller.
mcp_concepts.proxy_memory_handle: An opaque mem_* capability referring to full upstream data retained outside model context.
mcp_concepts.artifact_handle: An opaque art_* capability referring to a bounded, canonical or original output representation.
mcp_concepts.summary_mode: A model-safe response mode that stores the full payload in proxy memory and returns bounded, sanitized facts instead.
mcp_concepts.human_confirmation: A gateway or client-controlled decision recorded against an immutable execution-plan snapshot before state-changing process execution.

principles: MCP callers select operator-registered server IDs; they never provide arbitrary upstream base URLs.
Credentials are injected by the proxy from operator-controlled configuration and are never MCP tool arguments or model-visible result values.
Discovery precedes use: clients inspect collections, conformance, query surfaces, and process descriptions before constructing dependent requests.
Process identifiers, input identifiers, output identifiers, media types, and occurrence constraints are preserved exactly as advertised by an upstream process description.
Potentially large upstream payloads default to summary mode and remain behind opaque proxy-memory handles.
Every expected failure is represented by ok=false, operation, and a stable machine-readable error code.
State-changing process execution uses a stored plan and explicit human confirmation unless the operator intentionally exposes low-level direct-execution tools.
Referenced output retrieval is separately bounded, origin-validated, and represented through versioned output artifacts.

extension_points.purpose: Add an independently versioned translation for another OGC API family, for example Coverages, EDR, Maps, Styles, or Tiles.
requirements: Use a new module id and non-conflicting MCP namespace.
Declare dependencies on shared contracts rather than copying them.
Declare OGC conformance URIs, capability predicates, and MCP tool definitions.
Use x-* fields for implementation-specific metadata.

extension_points.purpose: Add a conformance-derived optional capability and a deterministic fallback policy.
requirements: State the upstream conformance evidence used to enable the capability.
State the fallback or fail-closed behavior when it is absent.
Do not claim proxy-side geospatial computation unless it is implemented and declared.

extension_points.purpose: Add an optional MCP tool without changing existing tools.
requirements: Provide an input JSON Schema, upstream mapping, result contract, side-effect classification, and error behavior.
Declare model visibility and any operator policy gate.

JsonObjectString.description: A UTF-8 JSON object encoded as an MCP string argument. The proxy parses it and returns invalid_json_argument when it is not an object.

server_id.description: Registered OGC server ID. An empty value selects the configured default for the relevant module.

summary_fields_json.description: Optional object: {"fields":["id","properties.title"]}. Geometry coordinate arrays are never eligible summary fields.

query_json.description: Implementation-supported OGC API - Features query parameters such as bbox, datetime, limit, offset, filter, filter-lang, properties, or sortby.

BoundingBox.description: [minx, miny, maxx, maxy] or six-dimensional OGC API bbox coordinates.

FeatureQueryPlan.description: A declarative, validated Features query. Property and sort identifiers MUST be advertised by ogc_features_describe_query_surface. Filters require CQL2 text capability. candidate_ci is discovery-only and cannot be used as final factual evidence.

query_text.description: Free-text OGC API - Records q parameter.

collection_id.description: Catalogue collection ID; empty selects the configured records default.

path.description: A relative upstream path. Absolute URLs are invalid.

execute_request.description: Process-specific execution body preserved without renaming advertised identifiers.

OutputManifestReference.description: The full canonical schema is spec/ogc-output-manifest.schema.json.

error_catalog.invalid_argument: The MCP argument is syntactically valid but violates a tool-level constraint.
error_catalog.invalid_json_argument: A JSON-object string argument cannot be parsed or is not an object.
error_catalog.not_found: A server-side identifier, plan, memory record, artifact, collection, feature, record, process, or job was not found.
error_catalog.unsupported_capability: The selected server does not advertise a capability required for this operation.
error_catalog.security_policy_error: A request violates operator-controlled URL, host, credential, reference, redirect, or private-network policy.
error_catalog.transport_error: The bounded proxy could not complete an upstream request.
error_catalog.upstream_response_error: The upstream OGC API returned an HTTP error response.
error_catalog.invalid_upstream_response: The upstream payload did not match the response shape required by the mapped operation.
error_catalog.workflow_error: A requested plan lifecycle transition is invalid or lacks human confirmation.

summary-mode.description: The full upstream payload is retained in proxy memory. The result includes a model-safe data summary and memory.handle. The model MUST NOT use raw geometry from this path for self-performed spatial analysis.

features-query-evidence.answer_rule: A factual client MUST make claims from data.facts only when data.evidence.safeToAnswer is true and MUST include data.evidence.qualifications.

output-manifest.description: Separates execution success from output retrieval, interpretation, and browser presentation readiness.

modules.title: Operator Registry
modules.scope: Expose only non-secret metadata for configured OGC API deployments.

translation.mcp_concept: A server-listing tool whose returned server_id is used by every networked module.

modules.title: MCP Proxy Governance
modules.scope: Capability discovery, opaque proxy memory, output artifact retrieval, and human-confirmed process plans.

translation.ogc_concept: Cross-cutting server policy, process execution safety, and bounded data mediation
translation.mcp_concept: Stateful MCP tools with opaque handles and explicit workflow lifecycle transitions

modules.title: OGC API Common
modules.scope: Landing-page, conformance, and relative read-only resource discovery for registered servers.

modules.title: OGC API - Features Translation
modules.scope: Discover vector collections, inspect query capabilities, retrieve individual features, and execute bounded evidence-aware collection queries.

translation.query_surface: A composite discovery tool merges collection metadata, conformance, queryables, sortables, schema, and a bounded sample.
translation.feature_query: A declarative MCP query plan is validated against that surface, translated to CQL2 text when applicable, and followed through same-origin rel=next pagination.
translation.data_boundary: The full GeoJSON FeatureCollection is retained behind mem_*; the model receives bounded coordinate-free facts and an explicit evidence gate.

modules.title: OGC API - Records Translation
modules.scope: Discover catalogue collections, perform bounded metadata searches, and retrieve a selected record for inspection of metadata and links.

translation.catalogue_discovery: The shared OGC /collections route is scoped to a Records deployment.
translation.search: Free text, bounding box, limit, and implementation-specific query parameters map to a collection items request.
translation.record_inspection: A record is retrieved by its upstream identifier and can guide selection of a data or service reference for later work.
translation.data_boundary: Potentially large catalogue results use the same summary mode and mem_* retrieval pattern as Features.

modules.title: OGC API - Processes and Jobs
modules.scope: Discover processes, inspect exact schemas, submit operator-gated direct executions when enabled, and track asynchronous jobs.

translation.process_discovery: GET /processes becomes a bounded MCP discovery tool.
translation.schema_preservation: GET /processes/{processId} exposes the upstream identifiers and input/output schemas without renaming them.
translation.safe_execution: The default MCP route is create plan → resolve → confirm → execute; direct execution is opt-in.
translation.output_contract: Execution and job results include an additive versioned output manifest.

tools.name: ogc_servers_list
tools.summary: List non-secret metadata for every enabled operator-registered OGC deployment.

upstream.notes: Reads configured registry only.

tools.name: ogc_proxy_get_capabilities
tools.summary: Return cached conformance-derived capability flags and deterministic fallback rules for a registered server.

upstream.notes: refresh=true bypasses the in-process capability cache.

tools.name: ogc_proxy_memory_list
tools.summary: List metadata for non-expired proxy-memory records without returning their full payloads.

upstream.notes: Memory records are TTL-bound.

tools.name: ogc_proxy_memory_retrieve
tools.summary: Retrieve a bounded slice of data stored behind an opaque proxy-memory handle.

upstream.notes: This pages only the stored payload; it never fetches new upstream pages.

preconditions: handle was returned by a prior summary-mode operation and has not expired.

tools.name: ogc_proxy_artifact_retrieve
tools.summary: Retrieve one bounded canonical or original process-output representation through an opaque artifact handle.

upstream.notes: A trusted renderer or download controller uses this capability; models do not receive large artifact bodies.

tools.name: ogc_proxy_create_plan
tools.summary: Create a stored process-execution plan after validating the process description, declared feature sources, and conservative input-schema constraints.
tools.http_mapping: Workflow: process discovery and description validation

upstream.notes: Persists a plan but does not execute the upstream process.

tools.name: ogc_proxy_get_plan
tools.summary: Retrieve the full stored plan, exact execute request, validation state, and lifecycle status.

upstream.notes: Plan state is TTL-bound and may be stored in memory or Redis.

tools.name: ogc_proxy_list_plans
tools.summary: List compact metadata for non-expired plans without copying full execute requests.

upstream.notes: Use get_plan for an exact execute request.

tools.name: ogc_proxy_update_plan
tools.summary: Correct a stored plan in place, preserve its plan_id, and repeat validation until it is ready for confirmation.

upstream.notes: The process body is not executed.

preconditions: plan is in needs_resolution or ready_for_confirmation state.

tools.name: ogc_proxy_confirm_plan
tools.summary: Record an explicit human decision for the exact plan snapshot previously displayed for review.

upstream.notes: Records a plan decision; it does not send the upstream execution request.

preconditions: A human has reviewed the exact execute_request.

tools.name: ogc_proxy_execute_plan
tools.summary: Execute a previously validated and confirmed stored plan by plan_id only.

upstream.notes: The proxy rejects unconfirmed plans before issuing HTTP.

result.summary_behavior: Stores complete result data behind mem_* and returns a sanitized summary plus output_manifest.

tools.name: ogc_common_get_landing_page
tools.summary: Retrieve an OGC API landing page from a registered Common server.

tools.name: ogc_common_get_conformance
tools.summary: Retrieve advertised conformance classes for a registered Common server.

tools.name: ogc_common_get_resource
tools.summary: Read a relative resource from a registered server as a safe, read-only escape hatch for unmapped OGC API modules.

upstream.notes: Absolute URLs, scheme-relative paths, and embedded upstream hosts are rejected.

result.summary_behavior: Summary mode retains full data behind mem_*.

tools.name: ogc_features_list_collections
tools.summary: Discover vector-data collections exposed by a registered OGC API - Features server.

result.summary_behavior: Summary mode returns bounded collection facts and mem_* for the original document.

tools.name: ogc_features_describe_collection
tools.summary: Retrieve metadata, extent, CRS declarations, and links for one advertised feature collection.
preconditions: collection_id is an advertised collection identifier.

tools.name: ogc_features_describe_query_surface
tools.summary: Build a safe collection query contract by merging metadata, conformance, queryables, sortables, optional schema, and a bounded sample.

upstream.notes: Optional discovery failures become warnings rather than hiding fields observed in a valid sample.

tools.name: ogc_features_query
tools.summary: Execute a validated, automatically paginated feature query and return coordinate-free facts with an explicit evidence-completeness gate.
tools.http_mapping: Validated GET /collections/{collectionId}/items with optional CQL2 text and same-origin rel=next pagination

upstream.notes: Pagination is bounded to 20 pages and 5,000 items. Cross-origin or path-changing next links fail closed.

result.summary_behavior: The aggregated FeatureCollection remains behind mem_*; data.facts contains bounded non-coordinate fact rows.
result.evidence_gate: Only data.evidence.safeToAnswer=true permits factual claims. candidate_ci results are discovery-only and must be refined with exact eq or in aliases.

preconditions: The proxy discovers the query surface before translating filters.
Every requested filter property is advertised filterable; every sort property is advertised sortable.
Versioned Features collections require an explicit datetime.

tools.name: ogc_features_get_items
tools.summary: Retrieve an OGC API - Features collection items response, returning a process-safe reference href and a model-safe summary by default.

upstream.notes: A guidance.reference_href and guidance.source identify the exact selected collection query for a referenced process input.

result.summary_behavior: summary is default; full GeoJSON remains behind mem_* and coordinates are stripped from model-facing fields.

tools.name: ogc_features_get_item
tools.summary: Retrieve one complete feature by collection and upstream item identifier.

tools.name: ogc_records_list_collections
tools.summary: Discover metadata catalogue collections exposed by a registered OGC API - Records server.

result.summary_behavior: Full collection metadata is retained behind mem_* in summary mode.

tools.name: ogc_records_search
tools.summary: Search a selected OGC API - Records catalogue by free text, bounding box, limit, and implementation-specific parameters.

upstream.notes: An omitted collection_id resolves to the operator-configured default Records collection; otherwise it is required.

result.summary_behavior: summary is default; full record collection remains behind mem_* for bounded inspection.

tools.name: ogc_records_get_record
tools.summary: Retrieve complete metadata for a selected catalogue record, including links that may identify data or services for subsequent workflows.

upstream.notes: An empty collection_id selects the configured Records default.

tools.name: ogc_processes_list
tools.summary: Discover executable processes, optionally filtering a bounded advertised process catalogue by keyword.

upstream.notes: search_text is proxy-side bounded discovery filtering, not an assumed upstream query parameter.

result.summary_behavior: Summary mode avoids copying large process catalogues into model context.

tools.name: ogc_processes_describe
tools.summary: Retrieve an advertised process description and preserve exact upstream input and output identifiers.

tools.name: ogc_processes_execute
tools.summary: Low-level direct process execution for interoperability testing; user-facing clients should use the confirmed proxy-plan workflow instead.

upstream.notes: Every HTTP(S) input reference is recursively validated before transmission.

result.summary_behavior: Outputs include a canonical output_manifest and use mem_* in summary mode.

preconditions: Call ogc_processes_describe and construct exact process-specific input names before use.

tools.name: ogc_jobs_list
tools.summary: List asynchronous jobs advertised by an OGC API - Processes deployment.

tools.name: ogc_jobs_get_status
tools.summary: Retrieve the current state of an asynchronous job and reconcile associated proxy-plan state when applicable.

tools.name: ogc_jobs_get_results
tools.summary: Retrieve a completed job result and its additive canonical output manifest.

upstream.notes: Referenced output retrieval, parsing, and presentation readiness are represented independently by output_manifest.

result.summary_behavior: Full job result stays behind mem_* in summary mode.

preconditions: The job should be terminally successful before result retrieval; a successful envelope does not itself prove a map-ready output.

tools.name: ogc_jobs_dismiss
tools.summary: Cancel or dismiss an asynchronous upstream job when the operator has explicitly exposed low-level direct-execution tools.
preconditions: A human or trusted client explicitly requested cancellation of this exact job.

capability_fallbacks.principle: A proxy MUST inspect cached conformance before optional behavior and report an explicit fallback or fail-closed outcome.

rules.fallback: Use execution_mode=auto without an async preference; do not invent a job lifecycle.

rules.preferred: Translate declarative filters to server-side CQL2 text.
rules.fallback: Reject filter-bearing ogc_features_query with unsupported_capability; do not silently perform unbounded client-side filtering.

rules.preferred: Request only the declared fact properties from the server.
rules.fallback: Accept the upstream response privately, strip geometry from model-facing facts, and emit a qualification that property selection was unavailable.

rules.preferred: Use the declared queryables schema as the authoritative field source.
rules.fallback: Merge bounded observed sample fields with queryables, sortables, and optional schema; observed-only fields are not marked filterable.

workflow_lifecycle.backend: LangGraph when available, deterministic local workflow otherwise

transitions.when: required inputs, units, CRS, sources, or simple literal types need clarification
validation is complete and exact execute_request is available
a human explicitly approves the exact displayed request
a human rejects or abandons the plan
the synchronous response or reconciled job status is terminal

workflow_lifecycle.execution_rule: ogc_proxy_execute_plan MUST reject a plan unless status is confirmed.
human_rules: The exact execute_request MUST be shown verbatim before approval.
The client MUST NOT auto-confirm a plan or invent missing spatial inputs.
A needs_resolution plan MUST be updated in place with ogc_proxy_update_plan rather than recreated.
Direct execution tools are not a substitute for the human-confirmed plan workflow in user-facing clients.

topology.memory: Correct for one process such as a single-worker stdio deployment; state is not shared across replicas or restarts.
topology.redis: Required for multi-worker or multi-replica Streamable HTTP deployments that need plan and handle visibility across workers.

state_persistence.multi_tenant_note: Plan, memory, and artifact handles are deployment-wide at the Python MCP layer. A multi-tenant deployment MUST add principal or session scoping before broad exposure.
